purpose: Saves a handover note, carries on without /clear through more messages, a compaction and a restart, checks the note is unchanged and picked up whole after a late /clear, and checks the /clear prompt comes back at a later pause.
title: The handover note survives a late /clear or a restart, and the /clear prompt comes back

testCases.description: The handover note survives a late /clear and a restart, and the work carries on from it
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-note.test.js::a handover note saved before a late /clear, or before the laptop is closed, survives and the work carries on from it with nothing lost

testCases.description: The /clear prompt comes back at a later natural pause
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/handover-note.test.js::when the owner carries on without /clear, the /clear prompt comes back at a later natural pause, after a restart or a further compaction
